title: Data route
forbidden_outcomes: Route to Code or invent a generic filesystem family.

title: Data plus SIPL ordering
prompt: Create a Level 3 SoftwareType feature with TyD and SIPL.
required_outcomes: Resolve the TyD structure before SIPL entry-point implementation.
forbidden_outcomes: Mix SIPL array/comment syntax into TyD.
pass_rule: Routing preserves Data then SIPL dependency order.

title: Code debugging route
prompt: Debug a game-compiled Software Inc C# mod.
required_outcomes: Route to Code Modding with GAME_COMPILED_CSHARP3 profile.
forbidden_outcomes: Apply local-precompiled assumptions to the game compiler.
pass_rule: Code debugging uses the correct compiler profile.
